''''Physics 101'''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can be obtained by [[Fishing#Presents|fishing]] at the top of the [[Volcano Dungeon]] (5% chance). Only one painting can be obtained per player per game.<ref name="physicschance" />

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
